slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental report on the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round, giving its answers as counts of countries. Angola appears only in the annex's score bands: digitization of the civil registration system under 35 per cent (the lowest band, with 20 other countries), legal framework 65-79, infrastructure and resources 65-79, planning and coordination 65-79, registration process 50-64, cause of death 50-64, vital statistics 50-64, overall 50-64. A composite band is not a statement of how Angola's offices record, and no system is named.
